alice: Heads-up — small perf regression spike on A100 when torch.compile + CUDA graphs hit dynshape-specialized path. Latency ~2.1x for single-token step compared to baseline.

ben: reproable? seqlen, batch?

alice: Minimal repro: seqlen=8 -> warmup, then seqlen jumps to 512. Using torch.compile + cudagraphs. Commands:
```
python -m runner --model /models/opt-6b --batch 1 --seqlen 8
python -m runner --step --seqlen 512 --torchcompile --use-cudagraphs
```
Profiler snip (ns/op):
```
before: 3.2ms/token
after: 6.7ms/token
kernel chooser: cuBlasGemmStridedBatched -> generic_gemm_heuristic
```

perf-bot: Perf alert: nightly-regression detected for inference-latency on a100-priority (2026-03-16). Link: http://ci/perf/1998

carol: My hunch: torch.compile leaves opaque dynamic shapes on capture so cudagraph/graph-capture path loses per-seqlen autotune metadata. Kernel selector falls back to safe generic kernel. Could be our autotuner cache key uses concrete shape not dyn-range.

dmitri: quick try: disable cudagraphs or force KERNEL_SELECTOR=prefer_asm to see if latency improves. Also try setting AUTOTUNE_BUCKET=seqlen_512.

alice: Ran quick experiments:
- disable cudagraphs => 3.1ms/token (good)
- export KERNEL_SELECTOR=prefer_asm => 3.3ms/token
- force AUTOTUNE_BUCKET=seqlen_512 => 3.4ms/token
So cudagraph capture seems to be the trigger.

ben: can you grab an nsight snapshot + the kernel selector debug log? Add --selector-log=debug and the cuda memprofile.

alice: Will collect and attach. For now opening a short-term mitigation: fallback in runtime to re-run autotune when cudagraph capture sees mismatched shape hash. I'll open a PR to gate the autotune cache miss and publish an opt-in env var. @carol @dmitri can you review the logic?

carol: yes — also add a deterministic regression test in perf/ci that toggles torch.compile+cg so we catch this in the future.

dmitri::+1: I'll add nsys script in the issue for capture reproducibility.

alice: Thanks — creating issue PERF-1423 and attaching logs. I'll post artifacts when uploaded.
